key_insight: Explicitly align image pixels to 3D generation so the model conditions each 3D point on the corresponding image pixels, producing much higher pixel-level fidelity between input images and generated 3D assets.
problem_solved: Reduces ambiguous 2D→3D associations in current 3D-native generators that inject image cues indirectly, addressing low pixel-level faithfulness (fidelity) in image-to-3D synthesis.
method: Establish explicit pixel-to-3D correspondence by projecting 3D samples into the input image and sampling pixel-aligned features to condition the 3D generator.
Integrate pixel-aligned conditioning into a 3D-native generation pipeline (geometry + appearance) so rendered views reproduce input pixels more faithfully.
Train with geometry- and appearance-level consistency losses (e.g., reprojective reconstruction/fidelity objectives) to enforce per-pixel agreement.
impact: Improves visual fidelity of image-to-3D pipelines, making generated assets more usable for downstream tasks like texture-preserving content creation, AR/VR, and vision-driven simulation.

Projection visualization: schematic of 3D point → image pixel correspondence with sampled feature vectors.
